function: Channel estimation: CNN refines LS channel estimates inside the iterative JCDD receiver for superimposed pilots, using despreading, attention, and soft-data confidence (pp. 5-7).
system: Uplink MIMO-OFDM, (Nr,Nt) = (2,2) and (64,4), 144 subcarriers, 14 symbols, 16-QAM LDPC, superimposed pilots; 3.5 GHz simulation, 2 GHz 2x2 USRP over-the-air; no RIS (pp. 7, 12).
method: Residual CNN denoiser with despreading, channel-wise attention and DNN interpolator; supervised MSE training (Adam, 100 epochs); embedded in iterative joint estimation-detection-decoding receiver (pp. 5-7).
data_channel: Simulation: 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL-C in Sionna, 3.5 GHz; OTA: DL estimator trained on 5x10^5 measured samples from a 2x2 USRP prototype at 2 GHz (pp. 7, 12).
test_conditions: Matched: same UE speed for training and test; mismatched: trained at 72 km/h, tested at 324 km/h; OTA static scenario, trained and tested on measurements (pp. 9, 12).
baselines: Classical: OP receiver (1P, 2P, 4P) with LMMSE, LMMSE-refined JCDD, VMP, VMP-L, perfect-CSI bounds; learned: none (pp. 7-10).
metrics: BLER and throughput (bits per frame) versus SNR; BLER gain under mismatched channel statistics; throughput gain over OP receiver; runtime and parameter count (pp. 7-12).
complexity: Table II: DL estimator complexity linear in resource blocks versus cubic for LMMSE and VMP; 6.87e4 parameters; runtime 1.33 ms (2x2) and 6.71 ms (64x4) (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 7: "Channel propagation is modeled using the clustered delay line (CDL) channel model with the CDL-C power delay profile [32]"; ref. [32] on p. 13 is 3GPP TR 38.901, and the DL estimator is also trained and tested on over-the-air measurements (p. 12).
q2_support: p. 9: "For the mismatched scenario, the DL model and correlation estimation are trained using samples obtained at a lower speed of v = 72 km/h", then tested at v = 324 km/h.
q3_support: p. 7: "The proposed SIP receiver is benchmarked against a conventional OP-based receiver that uses LMMSE-based channel estimation and detection"; the DL estimator is compared only with LMMSE, VMP and VMP-L (Fig. 8, p. 10), and no earlier learned receiver or estimator is compared.
q4_support: p. 10: "The computational complexity of the proposed DL-based estimator is also provided in Table II", with "a parameter count of 6.87 × 10^4" and runtimes of 1.33 ms (2x2) and 6.71 ms (64x4).
q5_support: p. 12: "the model is trained on 5 × 10^5 OTA samples collected under the SIP transmission scheme" and tested over the air (measured data); no code or data link is given, and Sionna [33] is only the simulation library (p. 7).
notes: Area 2: the learned part is the DL refined channel estimator (loss is the MSE on channel coefficients, Eq. 30, p. 7); BLER and throughput are receiver-level metrics, so area 1 would be an alternative reading; reviewer may confirm. q5=1 rests only on the clause 'trains and tests on measured data' (own OTA measurements); no code or data is released, so set it to 0 if that clause means public data only. Tables I-III and the figures were read from page images.
